title: KWh and cost calculation sheet
subject: Science
source: Seeded from science/y7 lesson 39 (kWh and cost calculation sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 39: Paying for electricity. To understand how electricity is measured and paid for, and how to avoid waste

model.title: A 2 kW heater runs for 3 hours. Electricity costs 25p per kWh. Find the cost.

questions.q: A 0.5 kW microwave runs for 0.2 h at 25p per kWh. Cost?
Find the power of three appliances at home with an adult (read labels only). Estimate daily use and calculate the daily cost at 25p per kWh.
questions.a: Pupils' own; for example kettle 2 kW × 0.2 h = 0.4 kWh = 10p
questions.model: Teacher does the kettle: 2 kW for 12 minutes a day (0.2 h): 0.4 kWh, 10p a day.

questions.q: A 60 W bulb is swapped for a 10 W LED, used 5 h a day. How many kWh are saved in 30 days?
How much money does that save at 25p per kWh?
Big question: kettle for 5 minutes or charger all night: which costs more?
questions.a: The kettle: about 0.17 kWh against about 0.04 kWh.
